conceptZh: 橙是像柳橙一樣明亮的橘黃色
object: a caped action-figure hero with an overlong cape and a capsule that bursts with oranges
morph: a capsule bursts open and juicy oranges roll out and land as the wood radical 木 and the 登 on top of a bowl, forming 橙
creativeAngle: 披風英雄打開扭蛋，一顆顆柳橙噴出來，把他的披風染成橘色；橙子滾落排成「橙」，詞用「柳橙」。
promptEn: An 8-second 3D animated toy clip on a clean solid pale aqua-white backdrop, locked camera. The only text is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 橙, centered in saturated juicy orange strokes about 70 percent of frame height, with the wood radical 木 on the left and the 登 part on the right, with its tent-like top and the 豆 below. Cast: Captain Flop, a chunky caped toy action figure with a bright blue cape three sizes too long that keeps flopping over his own head, and a big glossy capsule toy with a twist lid. Moment one, 0 to 1.7s: Captain Flop strikes a heroic pose, steps on his own cape, and spins the big capsule open with both hands. The first 橙 is spoken as the lid pops and a single orange shoots up. Moment two, 1.7 to 3.4s: a stream of round oranges bursts out, bouncing off his helmet and knocking his cape over his face; he does a wide-eyed double-take and catches one in each hand, juggling badly while the rest roll across the floor and line up into the vertical and crossing strokes of 木 on the left. The second 橙 is spoken as the last orange of 木 drops. Moment three, 3.4 to 5.0s: orange peel strips curl into the tent-shaped top of 登, orange slices slide into place as the small steps below it, and a halved orange makes the round bowl-like 豆 at the bottom, each one landing with a juicy bounce while Captain Flop yanks his cape off his face and gapes at the finished character. Moment four, 5.0s onward: he sniffs an orange and sneezes silently. From 5.0 to 8.0s the glyph is perfectly still and uncovered while Captain Flop holds one orange on top of his head like a hat and sways a small happy dance at the bottom of the frame, cape flapping, never touching the strokes. Audio: a warm friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 「橙、橙、柳橙」, slowly with clear tones as ㄔㄥˊ、ㄔㄥˊ、ㄌㄧㄡˇ ㄔㄥˊ. First 橙 near 0.7s, second near 2.4s, and 柳橙 around 5.3s as he balances the orange on his head. Stop after the word. Only soft pops and bounces, no background music. Soft studio lighting, vivid not neon colors, no flashing, no lens flare, no watermark, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, and no writing other than the single glyph 橙.
